The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust initial implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.31s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check the judge's lower reward (0.76) to identify potential gaps in documentation or edge-case handling.
